name: Vinza
world_status: a description exists but is not accessible
sweep_summary: Vinza (vinz1238) is not in the catalog and this search of works with stress in the title produced no readable first-hand statement on its word stress/accent. The single title-hit, Jouannet 1985 'Prosodologie et phonologie non linéaire', is print-only (HathiTrust search-only, Harvard Widener Library offsite); the BnF catalogue record (saved) subject-codes it as Kinyarwanda phonology/prosody, so Vinza is at most one of six D60 comparanda per the Glottolog/Maho note — relevance to Vinza itself unverifiable, likely tonal-accent material rather than stress; priority medium. Glottolog 5.1 holds 13 refs for Vinza; the only other descriptive one is Ko 2014, 'The Vinza language of Tanzania (Bantu, JD67)', UGent MA grammar sketch (ix+152 pp.), re-confirmed access-controlled (lib.ugent.be full text -> not reachable by automated download, UGent-only; biblio.ugent.be 0 hits) — that thesis is the high-priority acquisition for any Vinza stress/tone statement (ILL or request to author/promotor Koen Bostoen). Nothing else on Vinza phonology is indexed in Crossref, archive.org, HAL, theses.fr; Held neighbour files (: Harjula 2004 analyses Ha as pitch accent; catalog codes Kinyarwanda as tonal) do not license a Vinza coding. ( updated):, (Comorian review, not Vinza), earlier probe).

earlier_scan.source_named: Glottolog lists only classificatory refs (Schoenbrun 1994, 1997); no grammar or phonology of Vinza located.
